configuration.caption: Configuration
configuration.title: NeXT Configuration
configuration.globalsSnapshotIntro: Expected NeXT global variables from nxt.g / nxt-vars.g and their current values from the live RRF object model. Large vectors are summarized.
configuration.boardBootstrapHint: To load kit files before nxt-vars.g on boot, create empty 0:/sys/nxt-board-bootstrap.requested on the SD card. Use 0:/sys/nxt-board-bootstrap.skip to disable. Override with 0:/sys/nxt-user-board.g (see nxt-user-board.g.example on SD).
configuration.boardMismatch: Selected kit does not match the suggested kit from boards[0].shortName. Verify wiring before running bootstrap.
configuration.boardNoKitsPlatform: No vendored kits for this platform yet.
configuration.boardPinmapHint: Optional file for M950 overrides; edit on SD or extend in a future UI release.

toolManagement.caption: Tool Library
toolManagement.libraryIntro: Tools defined in the RepRapFirmware object model (configured slots, the tool in the spindle, and the configured touch probe). Magazine, job sequence, and ATC controls belong in the mos-atc plugin when installed.
toolManagement.noTools: No configured tools in the object model yet. Define tools in config.g / RRF tool table, or connect to the machine.

spindleControl.caption: Spindle Control
spindleControl.placeholder: Spindle control panel will be implemented in a future phase

messages.chooseSubsection: Use Control in the side panel: NeXT for Status, Configuration, and Probing; Tool Library lists configured RRF tools. Install the mos-atc plugin for magazine / ATC UI.
messages.menuMoved: NeXT features are under Control: NeXT (dashboard) and Tool Library (separate side item).
messages.toolLibraryInMenu: Tool Library has its own entry under Control in the side panel (same level as NeXT).
messages.notReadyShort: NeXT not loaded (global nxtLoaded is not true — see Configuration → NeXT globals)
messages.restartMessage: NeXT variables have not been loaded. The machine needs to be restarted to load the NeXT system.
messages.restartWarning: This will restart the entire machine. Ensure the machine is in a safe state before proceeding.
messages.probingComingSoon: Probing UI is under development. This panel provides minimal controls until the full probing UI is ported from the legacy implementation.
messages.basicProbeControls: Basic probe actions to interact with the machine from the UI.
